### 1 — Scene
A meal of stir-fried noodles with beef and vegetables, accompanied by a small mixed salad. Water and the unopened packet are excluded.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 25 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 12.5² ≈ **491 cm²**.
- **Salad bowl:** approximately 18 cm diameter; opening area = 3.14 × 9² ≈ **254 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Noodles, beef strips, cooked vegetables (including carrot and onion), glossy stir-fry sauce/oil, salad leaves, cucumber and tomato, and a small estimated amount of salad dressing.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below allocate the mixed foods without counting overlapping footprints twice. Sauce and dressing are allocated small equivalent areas.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked noodles | Main: 32% | 157 × 1.6 = 251 ml | 0.8 | 201 g | 150 | 302 |
| Beef strips | Main: 13% | 64 × 1.1 = 70 ml | 0.95 | 67 g | 230 | 154 |
| Cooked vegetables | Main: 10% | 49 × 1.4 = 69 ml | 0.6 | 41 g | 35 | 14 |
| Stir-fry sauce and oil | Main: 2% | 10 × 1.3 = 13 ml | 1.0 | 13 g | 300 | 39 |
| Salad leaves | Salad: 45% | 114 × 2.0 = 228 ml | 0.15 | 34 g | 20 | 7 |
| Cucumber and tomato | Salad: 25% | 64 × 1.6 = 102 ml | 0.6 | 61 g | 25 | 15 |
| Light salad dressing | Salad: 2% | 5 × 1.0 = 5 ml | 1.0 | 5 g | 450 | 23 |

Coverage totals: **57% of the main plate** and **72% of the salad bowl opening**, consistent with the visible portions.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **322 g of noodle stir-fry plus 100 g of salad** is plausible for these portions. Estimated total: **422 g and 654 kcal**. The amount of cooking oil and dressing is the largest energy uncertainty.
